newsitem.title: UK: General Cable says results on track for yr.
newsitem.headline: General Cable says results on track for yr.

text.p: Britain's General Cable Plc said on Wednesday its financial results were on track for the rest of the year.
The company's equity revenues -- its share of revenues of operating companies -- jumped 47 percent to 30.5 million stg in the first quarter.
Meanwhile, its pretax loss widened to 11.9 million stg from 6.2 million stg versus the year-ago period.

The provider of telecoms services and cable television said first-quarter residential telephone lines rose 29 percent to 177,900, cable television customers grew 30 percent to 154,600 and business exchange lines jumped 56 percent to 35,800.
General Cable said margins improved year on year at its business telecoms and residential telephony operations.
However, as expected margins were lower in cable television due in part to price increases from programme suppliers.
"Financial results are on track and provide a good basis for the rest of the year," the company said in its earnings statement.
General Cable said it expected to begin trials of new programming packages in the third quarter and implement the most attractive ones in the final quarter.
The company also said it expected to be able to launch digital television services in the spring of 1998. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
